blocks.title: Hybrid cloud
blocks.text: A hybrid cloud combines public and private clouds and lets data and applications move between them, giving more flexibility and control.
A company can run everyday work on a public cloud and keep sensitive data in a private cloud; at busy times it moves less sensitive work to the public cloud while critical data stay private.

blocks.prompt: Which deployment model combines public and private cloud features (MCQ 6)? Which is shared by organizations with common concerns (MCQ 2)?
blocks.explanation: (b) hybrid cloud. (c) community cloud: a cloud shared by several organizations with common concerns, such as hospitals or government departments; the chapter does not describe it, so this definition is general knowledge.

items: Hybrid cloud: public for everyday and overflow, private for sensitive data.
